@graph.headline: Budget-Friendly Playground Equipment Options for Schools in India
@graph.description: Affordable playground equipment options for Indian schools: what to buy first, how to phase a playground and where not to cut costs.

mainEntity.name: What’s the average cost of school playground equipment in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Prices vary by setup and size but typically start from ₹50,000 for basic structures and go up based on customizations.

mainEntity.name: Can we get playground equipment installed within a tight school budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. FunPlay Systems specializes in affordable setups, especially for preschools and government institutions.
Standard installations can be completed within 5–7 days post-approval.

mainEntity.name: Is it better to choose modular or fixed structures?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modular structures offer flexibility and scalability, making them a smarter investment for growing institutions.
